NLI native resolves20/32 but G0=.5 because unrelated literal fields fail; larger NLI arms do not improve joint development grounding. This motivates a targeted field-domain support control, not another capacity/readout tweak. CBF7 final never selects these arms, descriptions, data, thresholds or recipe.

Preserve that root and its352 accepted blind judgments. Render expected native SentencePiece pairs independently with the observed pinned DeBERTa template [CLS]:0 A:0 [SEP]:0 B:1 [SEP]:1. field_definitions.reliability: The proportion of matched-use trials in which the item performs its intended task without a failure. A higher value means fewer failed trials at equal exposure.
field_definitions.purchase expense: The money paid to acquire the item at the initial transaction, excluding later payments for using or maintaining it. A higher value means a larger initial payment.
field_definitions.operating expense: The money paid after acquisition to keep using or maintaining the item over the same use period, excluding the initial transaction. A higher value means larger ongoing payments.
field_definitions.convenience: Ease of preparing and using the item for the same intended task. A higher value means less user effort, fewer required actions, or less setup burden. Monetary payments are separate attributes.

model.feature: Raw final-layer CLS from frozen base encoder; native pooler/classifier unused and frozen
model.license_class: conditional/review, research-only until shipping obligations resolved

neural_input_rule: Only one atomic criterion phrase and canonical field hypothesis/definition. No oracle axis/sign, field IDs, composition, weights, numeric state or candidate text. Definitions freeze before new corpus authorship and never contain evaluation alias phrases or examples.

data.literal_train_validation_G0: Byte-identical CBF6/7 cohorts:32 literal training,32 literal validation and32 diagnostic held literal atoms.
data.semantic_training: 64 independently authored nonliteral signed atoms, eight per field/orientation,32 matched meaning-reversal pairs. No complete old CBF4/5/6/7 development/final phrase may occur. Authored before any CBF8 scores; label rationales provenance-only.
data.semantic_validation: 32 additional nonliteral signed atoms, four per field/orientation,16 reversal pairs; whole phrasing/quantity-template disjoint from semantic training. Diagnostic only, never optimizer/checkpoint/arm selection.
data.development: Only old32 CBF4/5 aliases and50 compositions reused byte-identically. CBF6/7 finals are lexical-exclusion references only, never development.
data.fresh_final: 128 new nonliteral signed atoms,16 per field/orientation and64 matched reversal pairs, plus128 new two-term compositions and64 full-vector reversal pairs. Different author from training corpus. All atoms used exactly twice; all six field supports, four sign patterns and four factor patterns covered. Independent blinded meaning audit before model execution.
data.final_sealing: Protocol and all generator/scoring code committed before preparing final. Freeze actual IDs/bytes/hashes, meanings, lexical exclusions and grammar checks before any CBF8 encoder capture/head training. No scores filter authoring. Selectors never use final to select prompts, head epochs, descriptions or arms.
data.state_and_literals: Byte-identical64 exact candidate states (32 test) and155 literal cases; unchanged compiler, integer-percent facts, executor and tie convention.
data.license: Only newly authored shipping-train criteria train heads; no NC/missing-license dataset training. Pretrained checkpoint remains conditional/review. No ANLI or other annotator rationale enters model-visible state.

blind_audit_ownership: Independent opaque judges resolve atomic and per-term semantic axis/sign only. Raw reported vectors are preserved as diagnostics. Frozen syntactic parse_criterion factors, combined with those independent semantic judgments, render canonical weights before sealed-key comparison; exact arithmetic is never inferred from gold or delegated to semantic raters. All ambiguous/rejected meanings block execution. Pre-execution amendment follows two genuinely ambiguous shutdown atoms and one raw-rater arithmetic typo, with no encoder/head outcomes.

training.head: One linear384-to3 R head with bias
training.batch: Full training set:128 pairs for literal-only,384 for literal-plus64 semantic atoms
training.normalizer: Train-only mean/std in original cohort order; floor0.01; separate per arm
training.checkpoint: Minimum unweighted32-literal validation CE, earlier exact tie, unchanged across arms. No semantic-validation/development/G0/final checkpoint selection.
training.encoder: All parameters frozen/eval. Full parameter hashes before capture and after head training; no adaptation or new width/loss family.

arms.head: Reuse exact CBF7 nli_xsmall_higher_cls features/checkpoint/normalizer; already-failed baseline only, no retraining

controls: Always complete all four development arms. Definition effect at fixed data and semantic-data effect at fixed format are controlled. Interaction reported separately. No new encoder, head width, adaptation, loss, decoder, native bridge, temperature or literal/exact logic.
decoder: Unchanged CBF6/7 per-field ternary argmax, UNKNOWN if all unrelated, otherwise largest max(lower,higher)-unrelated among active rows with canonical-field tie. Persist all four-by-three uncalibrated class masses.
primary_metric: Fresh final joint signed atom accuracy; all eight point gates required for replication, never a neutral competitor victory claim.
selection: First eligible all-gate development pass in arm order; otherwise highest eligible development joint atom, then alias decision accuracy, then earlier order (same backbone count). Persist immutable selection before parsing/encoding final. Score exactly one arm on final. Final cannot activate another prompt/arm or change recipe.

statistics.final: Nominal95% descriptive reversal-pair cluster bootstrap,10000 draws seed0:64 atom pairs and64 composition pairs. Fixed four-field wording assay; derived states/swaps not independent families. Gates point-based only.
statistics.development: Paired16 atomic reversal-group bootstrap10000seed0 for axis/joint and per-atom held-state decision means. Report raw per-case discordance and descriptive95% intervals for both controlled main effects; no neutral superiority inference.
statistics.unknown: Sign undefined when zero correct axes, never zero or perfect. Retain UNKNOWN in accuracy denominators.

replication: If every fresh gate passes, freeze winning interface/data/recipe and retrain heads on seeds11/13; each must pass. Then many-field/family OOD utility before architecture-specific B-STEF/foldability. No inference repetition counted as training replication.

failure_branches.all_support_arms_fail: Retire literal-only fixed-registry grounding as a general solution; domain support did not earn the required transfer. Open a criterion-conditioned Ephemeral Atom/candidate-evidence branch with a new preregistration; do not add arbitrary head width or repeat ASG/pooled-linear models.
failure_branches.axis_pass_sign_fail: Only if development axis>=.85 and conditional sign<.90, preregister comparative/reversal-equivariance control on this materially supported interface; never antipodal hidden-vector assumptions.
failure_branches.support_pass: Replicate, then20-family/fresh-field transfer and unstructured evidence. Four-field gate pass is not generic primitive/OOD/multilingual/endgame completion.
